cues: Comprehensive but conventional structure (goals, architecture, pipelines, risks, open questions) typical of default model planning output
No visible methodology-specific artifacts such as explicit assumptions ledger, numbered phases with exit criteria tied to a named framework, or self-check sections
Closing 'Open questions for you' and offer to produce implementation spec reads like a natural default assistant ending
Rollout phases and evaluation are present, but with generic placeholders (N days, K attempts, X days) rather than committed decisions
Dense tables and ASCII diagrams suggest polished style, but not an evident prescribed template
